item.title: [−1] Sensex flat at 73,598.67 and Nifty at 22,749.75 ahead of the Fed; midcaps gain 1%
item.description:
A volatile session ended largely unchanged as bank and IT profit-taking offset gains in pharma, realty and consumer durables. Follows Monday's break of a four-day losing streak. Stabilising.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — IT profit-taking

Why it matters: Crude near $114 and caution before the Fed decision cap large caps, while broader-market buying shows domestic demand for stocks remains intact.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Rupee edges up 3 paise to 95.12 per dollar on likely RBI intervention
item.description:
It traded between 95.09 and 95.24 as the dollar firmed before the Fed decision. Ongoing pressure near record lows, held in check by the RBI.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Weak rupee lifts earnings

Why it matters: A weak rupee raises the cost of imported oil and inputs; RBI dollar sales steady the currency but draw down reserves.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] Fed meeting begins; 94 of 100 economists expect a hold at 3.75–4.00%, all see a December hike
item.description:
US inflation rose to 3.7% in September while payrolls grew only 29,000. Decision due 28 October, 18:00 GMT; hawkish dissents possible. Ongoing.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — US demand uncertainty

Why it matters: A hold is priced in, but a firm signal of a December hike would strengthen the dollar and US yields, adding pressure on the rupee, G-Secs and foreign flows.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Foreign investor flows −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
